# Gregaria phase-reference DEG snapshot

These files are copied from the sister repository
`locust-comparative-genomics` and are used read-only in this project to annotate
fat body diet-infection DEGs with an independent phase-transition signature.

Source files copied on 2026-07-13:

- `DESeq2_results_sva_Head_gregaria_togregaria.csv`
- `DESeq2_sigresults_sva_Head_gregaria_togregaria.csv`
- `DESeq2_results_sva_Thorax_gregaria_togregaria.csv`
- `DESeq2_sigresults_sva_Thorax_gregaria_togregaria.csv`
- `overlapping_genes_head_thorax_gregaria.csv`

In the comparative analysis, isolated/solitarious animals were used as the
reference state. A positive phase log2 fold-change therefore means higher
expression in crowded/gregarious animals relative to isolated/solitarious
animals.
